verdict.rationale: Crossplane documents Environment Configs as in-memory data stores for Compositions, and Configurations as portable packages of resources. These hint at a way to feed environment-specific data into compositions, but nothing in the evidence describes separating dev, staging and prod as distinct stacks or workspaces. Missing for 10: explicit docs on per-environment separation (dev/staging/prod), a workspace- or stack-style isolation model, examples of environment promotion, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
